summary: Two men on inner tubes fell into the Cache la Poudre River at Picnic Rock while Poudre Fire Authority crews were training for swift-water rescue nearby; the men reached the opposite bank unhurt, and crews ferried them back across with a rescue boat, rope system, and seven rescue swimmers; a third man in the party reached the parking lot safely.
location: Cache la Poudre River at Picnic Rock
notes: Run 994 North Forty News chunk: North Forty News article published 2015-06-05 reporting the June 4 incident; 2015-06-04 was a Thursday.
